meta_title: AubeSonore — the first light of your next favourite songs
meta_description: A discovery radio, one track after another, free and ad-free. Keep the ones that stop you, find them again on your platform.
legal_publisher_body: AubeSonore is a non-commercial website published privately by Victor Lenain.
legal_hosting_body: The site and the radio run on a server owned by the publisher, in France. Traffic goes through Cloudflare, Inc. (United States), which protects and routes connections.
legal_data_controller: The data controller is Victor Lenain. Listening to the radio needs no account and creates no personal data.
legal_data_collected: If you create an account, we keep your name, your email address (and your photo if you sign in with Google), the tracks you keep, your preferred platform and, if you turn the alert on, your browser's notification subscription. To secure your session, we also record your IP address and browser.
legal_data_purpose: This data only runs your account: finding your tracks, opening them on your platform, letting you know when one of your artists is back on air, and counting your picks in “Most kept” (anonymously). Legal basis: providing the service you ask for. No ads, no profiling, no resale.
legal_data_processors: Providers: Resend sends account emails (confirmation, forgotten password); Google is involved if you choose “Continue with Google”; your browser's push service (Google, Mozilla or Apple) delivers the alerts; Cloudflare routes the traffic. Some are based in the United States.
legal_data_retention: Your data is kept as long as your account exists, then erased; database backups are kept for 14 days.
legal_data_rights: You can access, correct or export your data, or have your account deleted, by writing to
legal_data_cnil: You can also lodge a complaint with the CNIL (cnil.fr), the French data protection authority.
legal_cookies_body: The site only sets the cookies needed to keep you signed in. Your browser also stores your volume and language locally. No analytics or advertising cookies.
